question: Does the new unchanged base guard unit compile as strict binary64 Cortex-M4 objects under both candidate ABIs, and what actual sections, local frames and unresolved dependencies result?
scope: Separate minimal object-only annex for torque_guard.c; no amendment to original TC-03E three-unit protocol/cohort/attempts/receipts. No linking or target execution.

shared_helper.use: Only reviewed pure identity/archive/tree, environment, ELF/ARM-tag, stack and canonical dependency helpers. Do not call original fixed-three-unit compile_args/build or alter original protocol.

toolchain.name: Arm Toolchain for Embedded
toolchain.portable_location: workspace work/tools only; never globally installed
toolchain.verification: Verify retained archive size/SHA and the entire existing extracted tree against that ZIP with a fresh JSONL manifest before any executable. Reuse in place; no re-extraction, download or installation.
toolchain.license: Retain package licenses/notices and provenance; component licenses vary. No toolchain redistribution or binaries committed.
toolchain.original_GNU_preference_attempt: Official GNU installation guide read by ordinary HTTPS; official downloads page returned Access Denied. Earlier owner attempt encountered GitLab bot control. No bypass or guessed asset links; use this official fallback.

local_acquisition.policy: Reuse existing local official pinned archive/tree; no new download, install or global environment change
local_acquisition.preexecution: Reverify entire extracted tree against the pinned archive before ANY new executable, with a fresh per-file JSONL manifest and exact helper/driver/source/protocol hashes.

retained_outputs: Create-only new attempt outside source roots; exact three-file native snapshot, executed driver/helper and committed protocol copies.
Pre-call verified archive/tree manifest and tool/license identities; every command argv/cwd recorded before launching, stdout/stderr hashes/exit/timing retained.
Four little-endian ELF32 ARM relocatables with ARMv7E-M/M-profile/Thumb-2, VFPv4-D16/single-precision tags and actual hard/base calling-convention tag values.
Complete sections, Berkeley and SysV size reports, raw undefined symbol names, every emitted .su local stack record and qualifier, .d hashes and all source/toolchain dependency hashes.
Two same-condition repeat hash comparisons (one per ABI); source/header identities rechecked after completion. No guessed object sizes, helper cost, linked-memory budget or whole-stack bound.
driver_contract: Separate additive driver with this exact protocol/hash/source cohort. Original driver/protocol/build matrix remain untouched.
Reject existing output, source/header overlap, changed source/protocol/helper, unverified archive/tree/tools, any extra/reordered/removed flag, unknown unit/ABI and non-object commands.

Snapshot only torque_guard.c, torque_guard.h, torque_contract.h. tc_validate_allocation/tc_contract_reason remain unresolved external symbols as appropriate; do NOT compile/link their implementation for this annex.
Use explicit relative input filename in the snapshot and canonical dependency roots; preserve literal Windows drive backslashes, escaped spaces and continuations.
Strict binary64 guards/math flags unchanged. Ordinary floating environment assumptions do not become measured target behavior.

Run all four frozen rows; retain compile/inspection/metadata failures and denominator. Stop unexpected verification/launch failure conservatively. No source/math-policy adjustment after observing results without a separately frozen amendment.
Software-only tests cover frozen identity/cohort, exact flags/order, create-only/containment and matrix/metadata guards. Actual object calls remain a distinct receipt.
Independent practical source/artifact review and relevant host CI before scoped draft; no merges/deployment.
stop_rules: No compiler/inspection/version executable before root approves this annex plan and v1 is committed on new scoped branch from exact PR74.
Archive size/hash, extracted-file/tool, source/helper/protocol, unsafe path or command-contract mismatch stops before tool execution.
No linker, target emulator, startup/HAL, flash/CAN/hardware interaction or target numeric/timing test.
limitations: Exact STM32 part, team ABI/toolchain/library/startup, signal mapping and approved resource budgets remain unknown.
Object sections exclude linked helpers/libraries/startup/layout/runtime storage; unresolved symbols do not establish successful linkage or their runtime/numerical behavior.
Clang local stack frames exclude caller/callee/helper frames, interrupts/FPU context, scheduler and whole-program bounds.
Original three-unit experiment remains historical and separately identified; this annex does not silently add a fourth object to it.
No target runtime parity, continuous-time behavior, timing/deadline/WCET, firmware fit, HIL, CAN, vehicle actuation or safety approval.

primary_sources.support: STM32F405/407 DS8626 Rev12, section2/3.1: Cortex-M4 and single-precision FPU; no exact-part budget selected
AN4044 Rev2 section3/Table6: Cortex-M4 FPv4-SP only
Official portable extraction, target/FPU multilib selection, package licenses; Omax enables fast-math and is excluded
Clang float-ABI, contraction, freestanding, default-config and stack-usage flags; installed22.1.0 diagnostics are retained
Berkeley text/data/bss versus SysV section accounting
Tag_ABI_VFP_args=0 base/1 VFP convention; no presumed team ABI

research_attribution: Reuses the already reviewed primary-source target/ABI/strict-math/stack interpretation and actual pinned toolchain from TC-03E; new question/source cohort and acceptance denominator are separately frozen. No unmeasured resource number inferred.
